policy_notes: Normalized Cash Power is an analytical run-rate diagnostic, not reported FCF, FCFF, a forecast, or fair value.
Working capital uses a comparative-delta policy: retain the prior comparable cash pattern and normalize only the incremental current-period deviation.
Stock-based compensation is deducted as an economic cost in this model; no equivalent dilution charge may be applied again.
Annualization is mechanical and does not assert that second-half cash generation will equal first-half cash generation.
